# Requirements Quality Checklist: Active Recommendations in the Dispatcher Console

**Purpose**: Check completeness, clarity and consistency of the read endpoint and panel requirements before implementation
**Created**: 2026-11-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Focus**: API envelope + console panel, Human-in-the-Loop. **Depth**: Standard. **Audience**: reviewer (PR).

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for the panel while the first fetch is in flight (loading state)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the panel when the request fails (network error or generic 500)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the behavior defined for a recommendation whose `expires_ts` has already passed but whose status is still `proposed`? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the layout requirement defined for non-desktop widths, or is the exclusion of mobile explicit enough to bound the work? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK005 Is keyboard and screen-reader behavior specified for the cards and the status messages? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "ordered by rank" defined for ties and for ascending vs descending rank? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "bus" and "stop" display specified (raw id vs name or label)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the rounding and sign rule for «−N s de espera» defined for zero, negative and fractional `ewt_saving_s`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "same format as the header clock" for «Vence HH:MM» defined precisely enough to be tested, including midnight and the simulated-time source? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the boundary `age_s = 15` explicit (">" 15 s is stale, "≤" 15 s is ok)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "the same no-data message as the rest of the console" identified by a named existing string? [Ambiguity, Spec §Scenario 8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Do the panel's stale (15 s wall time) and the 5 s poll interval stay consistent with the SC-002 10 s visibility target? [Consistency, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Does the Q13 query in the data contract (no LIMIT, no snapshot filter) align with the "max 3, best ranked" requirement and the stale rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the "invalid stored doc" outcome consistent between the edge case (handled like existing endpoints) and the plan (generic 500 for the whole response)? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the TZ pinning statements consistent (spec says host-independent; the test env pins one zone)? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can SC-001 ("sees every active recommendation") be objectively measured? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Is SC-005 "existing tests still pass" bounded to named suites, given the scoped test rules? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the transition between states (ok → stale → ok) on refresh, including cards disappearing? [Gap, Spec §Scenario 4]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for a conflict marker whose `conflicts_with` target is not in the displayed top 3? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the behavior defined when fewer than 3 proposed recommendations exist while a snapshot is fresh (empty vs partial list)? [Coverage, Spec §Scenario 6]

## Non-Functional & Security

- [ ] CHK021 Is access control for the new endpoint stated as deferred (turn 2) with its exposure risk recorded? [Assumption, Plan §Evolution]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the read-only guarantee (no write, GET only) expressed as a verifiable requirement for non-GET methods? [Traceability, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the "no script execution from reason text" requirement scoped to all rendered fields, not only the reason? [Coverage, Spec §SC-004]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the dependency on the Q0 `age_s` read (new, next to existing `latest_snapshot_id`) documented in the spec as well as the plan? [Dependency, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the assumption that `gold.recommendation` is populated by the data layer during the demo validated? [Assumption, Spec §Key Entities]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
